title: Planting at Victoria Corner, Early 1900s
description: Early 1900s farming in the Victoria Corner location of the current NBBI. Farms were not built for wealth but for survival. Horses pulled wooden plows with spikes through new, broken soil. Oats, barley, hay, potatoes, turnips, and vegetables were planted. Fields were small, bordered by hand-laid stones from the fields or cedar rails.
